## Checks
- [ ] I control the source repository or provide publisher authorization.
- [ ] This adds a new version; existing versions, tags and bytes are unchanged.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py --write` and unit tests pass.
- [ ] No third-party implementation code or binary is included in this PR.
- [ ] No unsupported safety/certification claim is made.
- [ ] Any withdrawal includes time, reason, advisory and updated current selection.

Maintainer review: follow docs/MAINTAINERS.md; a passing check is not approval.
